title: Version 0.7.0 - New Pokemon, Spectator Mode and the City
message: Latest version: 0.7.0 Alolan Ninetales, Zoroark and Espeon join the roster! Watch custom matches as a spectator, explore a new social city lobby, and try out an expanded selection of held and battle items. New Pokemon - Alolan Ninetales joins the battle. - Zoroark joins the battle. - Espeon joins the battle. Spectator mode - Custom lobbies now have spectator slots for up to five viewers. Open-world city lobby - Explore the new chinese-inspired city and meet other trainers. Choose a Pokemon companion to follow you, use emotes, chat with other players and interact with NPCs. - The city supports desktop, controller and mobile controls. You can choose whether to enter it automatically on start in Settings. Items - Added missing battle items: Fluffy Tail, Goal Hacker, Shedinja Doll and Slow Smoke. Existing battle items have also been updated, including Full Heal, X Speed, X Attack and Goal Getter. - Expanded the held-item selection with Assault Vest, Weakness Policy, Exp. Share, Score Shield, Rescue Hood, Slick Spoon, Curse Bangle, Curse Incense, Charging Charm, Accel Bracer, Drive Lens, Big Root and Vanguard Bell. - Updated existing held items, including their stats and effects. Character changes Absol - Improved basic attack, Slash, Psycho Cut and Midnight Slash hit detection. Sucker Punch now includes a backward retreat. Flareon - Reduced Swift damage. - Reduced Heat Wave damage and its movement speed bonus from 20% to 10%. Heat Wave pulses can no longer critically hit. Gameplay and other improvements - Improved bush visibility and how combat contributions are credited for assists. - Improved aiming and targeting, bot positioning, battle UI and camera controls. - Various fixes and visual improvements.
